fingerprint.test_exclusion: path matches /pytest|[\\/]test_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\d*$/ (pytest tmp_path factory) => TEST, excluded from the production count
fingerprint.unattributed_rule: no owner line in the window => UNATTRIBUTED, counted but never credited
fingerprint.negative_control: the TEST bucket is non-empty on this machine, i.e. the exclusion actually removes records rather than matching nothing

honesty: This receipt proves the store is CONSTRUCTED by production processes (L2 REACHABLE). It does not by itself prove L3 CONSUMED or L4 DURABLE; those rungs cite code paths and the snapshot round-trip separately.
